row.body: my cab entry says the pasture treatment workers brushed off mustard-colored dust. not one fly remained before a cruiser waved us away.
row.title: cab note — on the cold night

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the mustard-colored dust while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
